question: 仓库 pallets/itsdangerous，截止时间 2026-11-16T06:31:18Z，冻结默认分支 672971d66a2ef9f85151e53283113f33d642dabd。Issue #347 提出的类型问题是什么？最终对应哪个 PR、哪个提交，实际改动覆盖哪些模块？请给出处。

claims.text: Issue #347 指出的类型问题是：`Serializer.dumps` 的返回类型不明确（`str | bytes`），原因是 `Serializer` 在 `__init__` 中决定自身返回类型；而对于 `URLSafeSerializer` 等派生类，静态可知返回类型是 `str` 而不是 `bytes`。
Issue #347 提议让 `Serializer` 泛型化，使派生类可通过继承 `Serializer[str]` 进行类型收窄，从而避免在每次使用 `URLSafeSerializer` 时写 `type:ignore` 或 `assert isinstance(a, str)`，并正确期望 `dumps` 返回 `str`。
PR #374 的描述说明 `Serializer` 现在接受一个泛型参数，取值为 `str` 或 `bytes`，用于定义 `dumps` 返回什么，而不是返回 `str | bytes` 联合类型。
同一描述还称 `URLSafeSerizlizer`（原文如此拼写）被类型化为始终返回 `str`，因此用户代码不再需要额外工作来满足类型检查器。
PR #374 的描述包含 `fixes #347`，这是把该 PR 与 Issue #347 关联起来的文字声明。

URL 为 https://api.github.com/repos/pallets/itsdangerous/pulls/374 的 API 元数据记录该 PR 的 `merge_commit_sha` 为 `385c0eb7501b121b1fddafe19c547073f5a458a0`，并记录 `merged` 为 `true`、`merged_at` 为 `2024-04-13T20:55:28Z`。

URL 指向提交 `385c0eb7501b121b1fddafe19c547073f5a458a0` 的文件变更记录中，`git diff-tree` 的 stdout 以 `M` 标记列出 `src/itsdangerous/serializer.py`、`src/itsdangerous/timed.py`、`src/itsdangerous/url_safe.py`，因此该差异记录覆盖这三个路径。

evidence.quote: Currently `Serializer.dumps` has an ambiguous return type (`str | bytes`) due to how the Serializer determines its own return type in `__init__` however for some of the derived classes such as `URLSafeSerializer` we know statically that the return type will be `str` and not `bytes`.
evidence.author: Daverball

evidence.quote: If `Serializer` were generic we could perform this type narrowing when we inherit from `Serializer` by instead inheriting from `Serializer[str]`. That way we don't need to `type:ignore` or `assert isinstance(a, str)` everywhere we use a `URLSafeSerializer` and correctly expect to get a `str` back from `dumps`.
evidence.author: Daverball

evidence.quote: `Serializer` now takes one generic parameter, either `str` or `bytes`, to define what `dumps` returns rather than a `str | bytes` union.
evidence.author: davidism

evidence.quote: `URLSafeSerizlizer` is typed to always return `str`. This makes it more convenient as the user code no longer needs to do extra work to satisfy the type checker.
evidence.author: davidism
